# The Aurum Luxury Collection by Stay Pattern

> A 4-star boutique hotel in Brein Hills, Astanpora, Srinagar, Jammu & Kashmir (PIN 191121).

## Property Overview
- Name: The Aurum Luxury Collection by Stay Pattern
- Location: 23A, Brein Hills, Astanpora, Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir, India – 191121
- Category: 4-Star Boutique Hotel & Luxury Chalets
- Google Rating: 4.8 / 5 (32 verified reviews)
- Proximity: Near Dal Lake (4.5 km), Nishat Garden (5.2 km), Tulip Garden (6 km), Pari Mahal (8.5 km), Shalimar Garden (8 km)
- Check-in: 2:00 PM | Check-out: 12:00 PM

## Accommodations
1. Luxury Bedroom Cottage: Handcrafted wooden cottage with king bed, ensuite bath, climate control, quiet mountain forest view.
2. Elegant Chalet – Dal View: Elevated cedar chalet with private balcony framing panoramic Dal Lake and valley views.
3. Sunset View Chalet – Dal View: Signature premier accommodation positioned for western golden-hour sunsets over Dal Lake.

## Meal Plans
- Room Only (European Plan)
- Room + Breakfast (Continental Plan)
- Room + Breakfast + 1 Meal (MAP Plan)

## Verified Amenities
- Free High-Speed Wi-Fi
- Free Private Parking on site
- On-Site Restaurant serving authentic Kashmiri Wazwan, Indian, Halal and vegetarian cuisine
- 24-Hour Room Service & Buffet Breakfast
- Air Conditioning & Climate Heating
- Airport Shuttle Service (additional charge)
- 24-Hour Front Desk & Concierge Desk
- Private Bathrooms with 24-hr hot shower
- Note: Swimming pool, spa and fitness centre are not on site.
